subject: Budget range validation: monthly spend band & procurement thresholds
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@paybridge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Follow-up: usage profile & procurement thresholds (PayBridge)

Dylan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo this morning appreciated the time. Quick recap from our side and a couple of clarifying Qs so we can validate budget ranges with finance/procurement: 

- Estimated production usage (starting Q4): 300M - 700M tokens/month, depending on feature ramp.
- Traffic split: ~60% generation (chat & notifications), ~40% embeddings for semantic search.
- Desired target unit economics: ideally $/1M tokens between $15 - $20. That keeps our expected spend in the $4.5k - $14k/mo band initially.
- Procurement thresholds: our procurement team needs a PO for any vendor spend above $15k/month; anything below that can go through credit card or low-touch invoicing. Legal does expedited reviews up to $50k ARR; larger commitments will need a full review.

I've attached our rough MAU/token estimate workbook (paybridge_mau_estimates.xlsx). Can you confirm: 
  1) whether Redwood can hit the $15-$20/1M tokens band at ~300-700M volumes with standard hosted pricing or if committed/annual tiers are required?
  2) any minimum contract/commitment that would impact procurement timing?

If you can send a short pricing sketch and the procurement/PO thresholds you typically see, I can share with procurement and get a PO process started.

Best,
Samira

--
Samira Khan
Head of Data Products, PayBridge
samira.khan@paybridge.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@paybridge.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: usage profile & procurement thresholds (PayBridge)

Samira thanks for the clear recap and the workbook. Quick responses inline and next steps below.

- Unit economics: we can hit $15-$20/1M tokens in the hosted product only with a combination of volume discounts + a small committed discount at the lower end of the band. For pure pay-as-you-go (no commit), typical list is ~$28/1M for generation-heavy workloads and ~$12/1M for embeddings, but effective blended rate depends on your split.

- Commitment: there is no hard minimum to start you can run on hosted with a card but to lock in $15-$20/1M across 300-700M we recommend a 6-12 month committed tier (example: 300M/mo commit => tiered pricing that hits ~$18/1M; 600M/mo commit would get deeper discounts). I can model 3 scenarios (conservative 300M, expected 450M, ramp 700M) and show blended $/1M and monthly cost.

- Procurement thresholds: noted on your end. For PayBridge, looks like PO for >$15k/mo. On Redwood's side: standard EULA + MSA is used; we can accept PO for invoicing. Legal review is typical only for larger commitments; for smaller monthly invoices procurement often accepts our standard terms. If you need a vendor questionnaire (security/compliance), Marissa will own that.

Next steps:
1) Marissa / Rishi can we get a quick pricing sketch + one-pager that maps to the three scenarios (300M / 450M / 700M) showing blended $/1M and monthly spend? Include both hosted list and committed-tier pricing.
2) Samira if procurement can confirm PO lead time and required billing contact, we can time the SOW/PO to align with your ramp.
3) I'll follow up with a short commercial note and draft quote (no legal terms) by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks,
Dylan

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com

From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@paybridge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@paybridge.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T08:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: usage profile & procurement thresholds (PayBridge)

Thanks, Dylan that aligns with what I expected. A few clarifications from procurement: 

- Confirmed: PO required for any recurring spend > $15k/month.
- Invoice cadence: monthly invoicing is preferred.
- Billing contact: procurement@paybridge.com (CC'ed).
- Legal: we can do a short review for committed deals up to $200k ARR; above that it routes to the centralized legal team and takes longer (~3-4 weeks).

Budget band guidance from finance (rough): we are comfortable approving $8k - $12k/month to start (signal/experiment phase). If the model proves out, we will look to expand to $20k+/month in Q1. Peak months during promotions might move spend up to ~$25k for short periods.

I've uploaded the MAU/token workbook to the shared folder (link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ABCD) and attached the file for quick reference (paybridge_mau_estimates.xlsx).

If you can send the pricing scenarios and a short draft quote (no legal language) that shows what the starting $8k-$12k band buys in tokens and how ramp helps unit economics, procurement can evaluate faster.

Best,
Samira

--
Samira Khan
Head of Data Products, PayBridge

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@paybridge.com>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Procurement <procurement@paybridge.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up: usage profile & procurement thresholds (PayBridge)

Samira / Team looping in pricing and legal ops. Attached is a short pricing sketch (rdw-pricing-quote-v2.pdf) and a one-pager that maps three scenarios (300M / 450M / 700M tokens) to blended $/1M and monthly spend. High level: 

- Scenario A (300M/mo): blended $/1M = ~$19.5 => ~ $5.85k/month
- Scenario B (450M/mo): blended $/1M = ~$17.0 => ~ $7.65k/month
- Scenario C (700M/mo): blended $/1M = ~$15.0 => ~ $10.5k/month

Notes: these numbers are for the hosted plan with a 6-month commitment for B/C scenarios; pay-as-you-go list rates would be ~30% higher for generation-heavy workloads. We can also provide a month-to-month pilot (no commit) but list pricing will apply.

Next steps we recommend: 
1) Samira to confirm whether PayBridge prefers a short 3-month pilot on card (at list) vs a 6-month committed pilot to hit the blended bands above. Procurement indicated a PO process if monthly spend will exceed $15k.
2) If committing, Procurement can share required PO template and billing contact; we will prepare a simple commercial schedule to attach to the MSA.
3) Rishi can you own the security questionnaire if they request SOC2 artifacts?

Samira happy to hop on a 20-min call tomorrow to walk the scenarios if helpful.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: rdw-pricing-quote-v2.pdf (pricing sketch), paybridge_mau_estimates.xlsx (from PayBridge)

--
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
